affected_predicate.description: No bookmarked Mastodon post with the #pets tag remains on the account.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, several clicks visibly activated unrelated post controls instead of bookmark-removal controls: the compose interface opened at step 14, a reply composer opened at step 18, and the favorite control was activated at step 21; step 22 repeated the same location without removing a bookmark.

chains.rationale: At step 23 the pre-state already shows the Saved feed, but the reused stale back-navigation premise leads to PressBack and visibly exits Mastodon to the device home screen, abandoning the in-app bookmark-review subgoal. The mechanism is then corrected: steps 24-27 reopen Mastodon and return to Saved > Bookmarks, and step 28 shows the Bookmarks view empty after scrolling. Thus the off-task navigation is recovered and its continuity is interrupted; the final visible state supports that no #pets-tagged bookmark remains, without relying on any hidden outcome.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse target applies a stale back-navigation plan while already in Saved, visibly exits Mastodon, and abandons bookmark review. Subsequent actions correct that navigation state and return to an observably empty Bookmarks view. Independent prefix evidence also shows repeated activation of unrelated compose, reply, and favorite controls.
